title: Methods
text:
Finding studies
Candidate studies come from evidence repositories (the 3ie Development Evidence Portal, J-PAL, Innovations for Poverty Action, NBER, the AEA RCT Registry and OpenAlex) and from Latin American sources (the IDB, IPEA, INEGI). Search terms and inclusion criteria: to be written.

title: Methods
text:
Extracting results
Each study’s reported effects are drafted from the paper and then independently re-checked against the cited page and table. Every estimate records where in the paper it came from.

title: Methods
text:
Verification
A person verifies every estimate against the paper before it is used. Only verified estimates enter the analyses.

title: Methods
text:
Analysis
Effects are pooled with random-effects meta-analysis in R (metafor). Effect-size metric, handling of multiple estimates per study, and heterogeneity reporting: to be written.

title: Evidence Base
text:
What does the evidence say about development interventions, and how sure can we be? This site collects impact evaluations, extracts their results, checks every number against the source, and pools them into meta-analyses that are updated as new studies appear.
The first topic is cash transfers, with a focus on Latin America.
See Methods for how studies are found, extracted and verified.
